# config_path { #crossrepo.config.config_path }

```python
crossrepo.config.config_path()
```

Location of the configuration file that applies everywhere.

Honours ``XDG_CONFIG_HOME``.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Path](`pathlib.Path`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Path of ``config.toml``, whether or not it exists.
